name: Orylle

facts.text: Level 83, 40,000 health. Fights linked with Orshom Brong; drawn past 3,800 she walks home.
She throws a random raider to a fixed spot about 1,200 units back up her hall (61: 31406, 69599).
Krondon's final encounter in the raid list; a February 2003 guide put her and Orshom at fifty or more players.
That she is the 'warrior queen' of the existing bot line is Living Server writing.

story:
Orylle came up out of the deep seams at the head of the thrawn ogres and took Krondon without burning it, which is the most dangerous thing anyone did in Morgana's war. She kept the hall's order and put ogres in every chair. She has no use for the old learning, but she understands a hall: a queen at the end of it, a champion at her side, a herald on the road and lords in every room below. Those who reach her are not killed at once. She seizes the boldest and hurls them back down her hall toward the door, a queen's answer to a guest who came in without leave. If they walk back, she will fight them. She has never been afraid of a crowd; she simply makes the crowd come to her one thrown man at a time, while Orshom Brong burns at her shoulder.

Where she came from. Orylle was born in the deep seams under the isles, where the thrawn ogres have dug since before the hall-folk built their hall, and she was the first of her people to climb out and look at the world they had been digging under. She saw the hall of Krondon, old and half empty, its champions dead and its storms grown gentle, and she understood something no ogre before her had understood: that a people could take a thing without breaking it.

How she rules. So she took Krondon whole. She walked its rooms reading the titles over the doors, which she cannot read, and asked the ghosts what they meant, which the ghosts told her, and then she gave every title to an ogre. She bargained with the storm-keeper rather than fight him. She let Beran keep the pitch and Deben keep the horn and Morgus keep the school. She put her herald on the road and her champion at her side, and she sits at the end of the deepest hall where the ealdor once sat. She does not kill the bold who reach her chair. She seizes the boldest and hurls them back down the hall toward the door, a queen's answer to a guest who came in without leave, and waits to see if they come back properly. Those who walk back, she fights. The raids that lost to her lost to the walk.
legend:
Fifty or more, and kill her with Orshom in mind: they come together, so the cold-damage casters are on him and everyone else is on her. When she throws you, do not release and do not panic. Walk back up the hall and get in. The raids that lost to her lost because the thrown men wandered off.

Keep the walking paths open between the throw spot and her chair, and keep a healer near the throw spot for the falls. She hits hard but fair; the danger of Orylle is always the scattering, never the blows. Walking back is the whole trick.

loremasterTopic.text: The warrior queen of Krondon. She took the hall without burning it and put an ogre in every chair. She hurls the bold back down her hall. Walk back to her; the raids that wandered off are the ones we sing about as lost.

bookPage: Orylle does not slay a challenger who reaches her chair. She hurls him back down her hall toward the door, as a queen might sweep an unbidden guest from her hearth, and waits to see if he returns. The ogres say she has done this to a hundred men and that only the ones who walked back were worth killing. I was thrown twice. The second time I walked back past Lurfos's post and the ghosts on the walls, and they watched me come, and I think they were glad of it. Orshom Brong burned at her shoulder through all of it. They fell together.
